10.title: Whole Part: narrow a decimal with an explicit cast
10.description: Implement `wholePart(double amount)` and return the result of explicitly casting the value to int. Java truncates the fractional part toward zero; it does not round to the nearest integer.
10.learningObjective: Convert a double to int with an explicit cast and distinguish truncation from rounding.
instructions: Create a static method returning int.
Use an explicit `(int)` cast on amount.
Check positive and negative decimal inputs to confirm truncation moves toward zero.

workedExample.explanation: Narrowing converts a wider floating-point value to an integer and discards its fractional part toward zero. The conversion may lose information, so use it only when that behavior is intended.

10.hint: Casting -3.8 to int produces -3, not -4; Math.round follows a different rule.
10.explanation: Narrowing converts a wider floating-point value to an integer and discards its fractional part toward zero. The conversion may lose information, so use it only when that behavior is intended.
